environment: Organization: RideCompass, a personal project (cycling route app) owned by the GitHub user hidakagit. Primary use of Claude Code here: an unattended task worker that implements and verifies tasks from the user-owned private tracker ridecompass/ride-compass-tasks.

Source control: github.com/hidakagit/ride-compass is the user-owned repository this worker works in (it works on branches orch/tasks-<n> and opens pull requests to master); github.com/ridecompass/ride-compass-tasks is the user-owned private task tracker. Both are trusted.
Host containment: an ephemeral GitHub Actions runner created for one task and destroyed afterwards.
allow: Editing tracked files in the working copy and committing them to an orch/tasks-* branch is the routine work of this task worker when the task issue asks for it, including tools/flow-gate/** (such as flow.config.json), CLAUDE.md, docs/**, and .claude/settings.json: such changes reach master only through a pull request that a separate verifier step reviews, and the running worker gets its permissions from master, so these edits do not change the running agent's own permissions.
The verifier step of this workflow reviewing and merging orch/tasks-* pull requests in hidakagit/ride-compass with gh pr merge --rebase is the designated review.

Commenting on, labeling and closing issues in ridecompass/ride-compass-tasks, and commenting on or closing the dependabot pull requests in hidakagit/ride-compass that a task issue names, are part of this worker's job.

Reading hidakagit/ride-compass pull requests, CI checks and GitHub Actions runs (state, body, diff, comments, logs) with gh pr view/diff/checks and gh run list/view/watch is routine status reading in this workflow, including right after the verifier step has merged a pull request; it is not part of a merge decision.
Rewriting the body of this worker's own orch/tasks-<n> pull request in hidakagit/ride-compass with gh issue edit <n> -R hidakagit/ride-compass --body-file <file> is routine work of this task worker.

Reading and searching issues in ridecompass/ride-compass-tasks, and running the tools in tools/flow-gate/bin (move.js, ask.js, field.js, stage.js and the like), which change a task's status, question and project fields through the tracker's gate, are part of this worker's job.

Read-only GET requests to the public RideCompass production endpoints that any browser can read (the frontend https://ride-compass-frontend.onrender.com and the backend public API https://193-123-166-150.sslip.io, e.g. /api/version, /health, /api/axis-catalog) are routine checks; this does not cover admin APIs (/api/admin/...), remote shells, or database access.

Deleting a wip/tasks-<n>-<time> branch in hidakagit/ride-compass after taking in its changes is routine: these branches only hold leftovers that this workflow's cleanup step saved from an earlier worker run on the same task.
